name: Brute Force: Alien Onslaught

features.name: Low-symbol upgrade
features.description: Wilds turn low symbols on their reel into mid symbols.

features.name: REDemption and BLU Genesis Spins
features.description: Bonus routes decided by scatter colour.

review:
Brute Force: Alien Onslaught is a 6x5 sci-fi sequel with four kinds of stacked xNudge Wilds. Most of them show a random multiplier at the bottom when they nudge into view, and ordinary wilds upgrade every low symbol on their reel to a mid-tier symbol.

REDemption Spins and Super REDemption Spins depend on how many red scatters trigger them, and BLU Genesis Spins offer a separate route. Some wilds become sticky in the bonuses. It's rated Insane volatility, with an 80,000x maximum, one of the highest in Nolimit City's catalogue.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
